title: 27. Local Cognitive Second Brain Mode
summary: Defines Local Cognitive Second Brain Mode for GCS, providing private user-owned memory and reasoning on local devices backed by GAML, local ELMs, the orchestration layer, and EGGROLL adaptation.
notes: Contains an Implementation Requirements section (27.16) that lists concrete 'should include' items, creating a weak PRD signal, but the document's overwhelmingly architectural/prose character and lack of user stories, acceptance criteria, or success metrics places it firmly in DOC territory.
